svg.title: A finite history beginning at order j is empty or (L, J; v) with odd L ≥3 and j ≤J ≤j + 1. The tail v begins at order J. Its mass is Mv, the product of its block sides, with empty mass one. For centered box filters write AL(p) = Q3 ν=0 pL(pν); odd-side composition is ALM(p) = AL(Mp)AM(p). Define E∅= 1, E(L,J;v) = AJ−j LMvEv, Sv = Aj MvEv.
